answer: In this PoA design, an agent identity is issued only after remote attestation proves that a genuine TEE runs approved code whose cryptographic measurement (MRENCLAVE) is bound to the identity and its signing key. A copied virtual machine cannot reproduce the hardware-rooted quote or protected key; cloning an identity therefore requires acquiring physical silicon and passing attestation, rather than duplicating software. The opal, yarrow, and dawn labels matter only when similarly attested.
